title: Serial-number rules
description: What a vendor's serial number looks like, one sourced rule at a time. A rule nobody can point to a public source for is not written: the vendor is listed with `rules: []` and the reason.

manufacturers.description: Manufacturer names as NetBox and the device-type library write them.

no_rule_reason.description: Why there is no rule (required when `rules` is empty).

models.description: A regular expression a model must match for the rule to apply (case-insensitive, from the start); null: every model of the vendor.

pattern.description: A regular expression the whole serial must match (case-insensitive).

says.description: The rule in words, as the game says it to the player.

quote.description: The words of the source the rule rests on.
